blocks.en: In this section we generalize the eigenvalue problems of linear algebra to operators on Banach spaces. One of our main goals is to generalize the following theorem.
blocks.zh: 本节将线性代数中的特征值问题推广到 Banach 空间上的算子. 主要目标之一是推广以下定理.

blocks.en: Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ symmetric matrix. Then $A$ has $n$ eigenvalues $\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_n$ (counted with respect to algebraic multiplicity), and all of these eigenvalues are real. Furthermore, there is an orthonormal basis $\{\bm{e}_1,\ldots,\bm{e}_n\}$ for $\mathbb{R}^n$, such that $\bm{e}_i$ is an eigenvector corresponding to $\lambda_i$.
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为 $n\times n$ 对称矩阵. 那么 $A$ 有 $n$ 个特征值 $\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_n$ (按代数重数计数), 且这些特征值全为实数. 此外, $\mathbb{R}^n$ 有一组标准正交基 $\{\bm{e}_1,\ldots,\bm{e}_n\}$, 使 $\bm{e}_i$ 为对应于 $\lambda_i$ 的特征向量.
blocks.label: thm:symmetric-matrix-spectral-basis

The proof of this is given in any good elementary linear algebra text. The result will be a corollary to the theorems we prove below about self-adjoint compact operators.

One of our first tasks is to generalize the concept of eigenvalues and eigenvectors to accommodate the operators considered in this section (which may be defined in infinite-dimensional spaces and may be unbounded).
blocks.zh:
任何一本好的初等线性代数教材都给出了这一结果的证明. 这一结果将成为下面要证明的关于自伴紧算子的定理的推论.

首先要做的工作之一是推广特征值和特征向量的概念, 使之适用于本节所考察的算子 (这些算子可能定义在无穷维空间上, 也可能是无界的).

blocks.en: If $X$ is a Hilbert space, we refer to the dimension of $\mathcal{R}(A_\lambda)^\perp$ as the \textbf{deficiency} of $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$.
blocks.zh: 若 $X$ 为 Hilbert 空间, 则将 $\mathcal{R}(A_\lambda)^\perp$ 的维数称为 $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$ 的\textbf{亏数}.
blocks.label: def:spectral-deficiency

blocks.en: Note that by our definition, $\lambda\in\sigma(A)$ can have nonzero deficiency and not be in the compression spectrum. Some authors define the compression spectrum to be all $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$ such that the deficiency is nonzero, but in this case the point spectrum and compression spectrum are not necessarily disjoint.
blocks.zh: 注意, 按这里的定义, $\lambda\in\sigma(A)$ 可以具有非零亏数而不属于压缩谱. 有些作者将压缩谱定义为所有亏数非零的 $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$ 所组成的集合, 但这样一来, 点谱和压缩谱就未必互不相交.

blocks.en: One of the fundamental results of linear algebra is that for a linear operator $A$ on a finite-dimensional space the continuous spectrum and the compression spectrum of the operator are empty; i.e., the complex plane can be decomposed into regular values and eigenvalues of the operator.
blocks.zh: 线性代数的一个基本结果是, 对有限维空间上的线性算子 $A$, 其连续谱和压缩谱都是空集; 即复平面可分解为该算子的正则值和特征值.
blocks.label: ex:finite-dimensional-spectrum-regular-eigenvalues

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For a simple example of an operator with a spectral value that is not an eigenvalue, consider the right-shift operator $S_r:\ell^2\to\ell^2$. The complex number $\lambda=0$ is an element of the spectrum. To see this we recall that the resolvent operator $R_0(S_r)$ is simply the left-shift operator $S_l$ operating on the domain $\{1,0,0,\ldots\}^\perp$, and while this operator is bounded, its domain is not dense in $\ell^2$. Thus, $\lambda=0$ is in the compression spectrum of $S_r$ and has deficiency $1$.
blocks.zh: 作为谱值并非特征值的算子的一个简单例子, 考察右移算子 $S_r:\ell^2\to\ell^2$. 复数 $\lambda=0$ 是谱的元素. 为看出这一点, 回忆预解算子 $R_0(S_r)$ 就是作用在定义域 $\{1,0,0,\ldots\}^\perp$ 上的左移算子 $S_l$. 虽然这个算子有界, 但其定义域在 $\ell^2$ 中不稠密. 因而 $\lambda=0$ 属于 $S_r$ 的压缩谱, 亏数为 $1$.
blocks.label: ex:right-shift-compression-spectrum

blocks.en: Spectral theory is a very broad and well studied subject. Our treatment of it here is of necessity very cursory; our aim is primarily to develop the tool of eigenfunction expansions. Thus, we begin with a basic theorem about eigenvectors.
blocks.zh: 谱理论是一个范围非常广且已有充分研究的课题. 这里的论述必然十分简略; 主要目标是建立特征函数展开这一工具. 因而先给出一个关于特征向量的基本定理.

blocks.en: If $\lambda_i$, $i=1,\ldots,n$, are distinct eigenvalues of the operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ and $x_i\in\mathcal{N}(A_{\lambda_i})$ are corresponding eigenvectors, then the set\[\{x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\}\]is linearly independent.
blocks.zh: 若 $\lambda_i$, $i=1,\ldots,n$, 是算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的互不相同的特征值, $x_i\in\mathcal{N}(A_{\lambda_i})$ 为对应的特征向量, 则集合\[\{x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\}\]线性无关.
blocks.label: thm:distinct-eigenvalue-eigenvectors-independence
